activity_summary: You rehearsed the messenger in a dark house. Sincler took three paces and stopped. Nick held two beats after "The King your father," and then said "Dead for my life." Burbage answered the twelvemonth and a day in a plain voice, with "That's too long for a play." Sam sang the cuckoo once. The note was a little thick, and the word still came. Phillips did not give him a second try. You had no new page with you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set Nick's two beats, asked for the plain voice, and left the new page at home.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Cleared Sincler's line and took the twelvemonth plain.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Held the two beats and spoke "Dead for my life."

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Put the line on Nick's chest, and stopped Sam after one thick note.

entities.name: John Sincler
entities.context: Walked three paces and stood by the pillar.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Sang the word through a thick throat, and did not get a second try.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The messenger, and a thicker note

facets.activity: Rehearsed the messenger, and Sam sang once

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: I can hold it low, so the wind does not take it.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.

quotes.speaker: sam_latchet
quotes.text: The word came. I am not hoarse.
